title: Rarity of Singletons Matters & Supplementary Materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.22604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating missing-mass and unseen-species counts from finite samples relies heavily on rare-event occupancy statistics, particularly singletons. In small-sample regimes, these statistics can be highly variable, making classical estimators sensitive to sampling fluctuations and potentially unreliable. We propose a fragility-aware (FA) framework that explicitly quantifies this sensitivity and adaptively regularizes conventional missing-mass and unseen-species estimators. Using singleton-based fragility measures derived from probability mass and occupancy counts, we formulate an entropy--Kullback--Leibler (KL) optimization that adjusts the reliance on base estimates according to their fragility. The resulting objectives are strictly concave, admit unique closed-form solutions, and require no Poissonization or asymptotic approximations. translated_title: 单例稀有性至关重要（附补充材料）
translated_abstract: 从有限样本中估计缺失质量与未见物种数量，很大程度上依赖于稀有事件的占用统计量，尤其是单例。在小样本情形下，这些统计量可能具有高度波动性，使得经典估计方法对抽样波动十分敏感、潜在不可靠。我们提出了一个脆弱性感知框架，显式量化这种敏感性，并对传统的缺失质量与未见物种估计量进行自适应正则化。利用由概率质量与占用计数导出的基于单例的脆弱性度量，我们构建了一个熵-Kullback-Leibler（KL）优化问题，根据基础估计量的脆弱性来调整对它们的依赖程度。所得到的目标函数严格凹，具有唯一的闭式解，且无需Poisson化或渐近近似。该框架为经典估计方法（包括Good-Turing和Good-...）提供了轻量级的修正。
tldr: 提出脆弱性感知（FA）框架，通过量化单例统计量的脆弱性，以严格凹且具有唯一闭式解的熵-KL优化对经典缺失质量与未见物种估计量进行自适应轻量级修正。
en_tdlr: A fragility-aware (FA) framework that quantifies singleton-based sensitivity and adaptively regularizes classical missing-mass and unseen-species estimators through strictly concave entropy-KL optimization with unique closed-form solutions and no need for Poissonization or asymptotic approximations.
